quandoUsar: Secondary tasks on mobile where a preview helps before the full view: order summary, sharing options, filters, trip details.
Content that people drag between half height and almost full screen, with rest heights such as `detents={[0.4, 0.85]}`.
Flows that need to know where the sheet stopped, through the index that `onDetentChange` reports.
quandoEvitar: Use `dialog` when the decision needs to interrupt the person in the center of the screen.
Use `drawer` for side panels on wide screens; this sheet is at most 36rem wide and is centered on the bottom edge.

teclado.acao: With focus on the sheet, open to the greatest height; when already open, scroll the content.
With focus on the sheet, scroll the content up.
On the handle, go up or down one rest height; going down it stops at the smallest, without closing.
On the handle, go to the greatest or smallest height.
On the handle, toggle between the smallest and greatest height.
Closes the sheet and returns focus to the `trigger`; while it is open, focus stays trapped in it.

acessibilidade: It is a Radix modal dialog: `title` becomes the accessible name, `description` the description, and the rest of the page leaves the accessibility tree while the sheet is open.
On open, focus goes to the sheet itself; the handle is a button with `aria-expanded` and the label “Expand sheet” or “Collapse sheet”.
Each height change is announced in a polite `aria-live` region (“Sheet expanded”, “Sheet collapsed”); these texts are fixed in English, and only the close button accepts its own label (`closeLabel`).
movimento: The sheet follows the finger 1:1 downward and resists like elastic above the greatest height; on release, velocity projects the destination and a fast gesture always advances at least one height.
A fast downward gesture from the smallest height closes the sheet keeping its velocity; the backdrop darkening follows the position instead of a fixed time.
With “reduce motion” on, the sheet goes straight to each height and only fades on enter and exit; content scrolling is no longer smooth.
responsivo: The width is `min(100%, 36rem)` and the heights are fractions of `100dvh`; the bottom spacing respects the device safe area (`safe-area-inset-bottom`).

The content only scrolls at the greatest height; below it, dragging, spinning the wheel, or tabbing to an off-screen field opens the sheet first, and an observer repositions it when the window height changes.
notasIA: `title` is required and `detents` are fractions of the window height (default `[0.45, 0.92]`), sorted by the component; `initialDetent` is the index in that sorted list.
Pass the button in `trigger` so focus returns to it on close; to close from inside, wrap the action in `BottomSheetClose asChild`.
On touch, dragging vertically over the content moves the sheet until it is fully open; only then does the content scroll. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/bottom-sheet/bottom-sheet`.
